thread:
zara: heads-up — flaky behavior in sampleapp on Pixel 8 / Android 14 when resuming big file uploads over flaky wifi. server sees two POSTs sometimes. stack: retrofit 2.9 + okhttp 4.11 + our kotlin-sdk client.

mike: repro steps? sounds like double-send from retry logic.

zara: repro: start upload (streaming RequestBody via InputStream), kill network for ~200ms mid-stream, restore. okhttp throws IOException on write -> our RetryInterceptor retries and second attempt fails with IOException: request body is not repeatable OR server accepts duplicate.

tony: interesting — does the Java SDK behave same?

zara: nope. java-sdk sets client.retryOnConnectionFailure=false by default; kotlin-sdk was accidentally using true in default OkHttp config. parity bug.

katie: that explains why some customers hit it and others don't. we should align defaults.

mike: short-term mitigations: 1) set retryOnConnectionFailure=false in kotlin-sdk default client; 2) detect streaming/unrepeatable bodies in interceptor and skip retry; 3) recommend idempotency key header for uploads. longer-term: provide a buffered upload helper that writes to temp file so body is repeatable.

ton y: can we auto-detect non-repeatable bodies? maybe use body.contentLength() == -1 || request.body() is instance of StreamRequestBody marker.

katie: yeah contentLength==-1 is a good heuristic. also some RequestBody subtypes like CountingRequestBody might still be repeatable. not perfect but practical.

mike: propose change list: A) change kotlin-sdk default to retryOnConnectionFailure=false B) update RetryInterceptor to check a tag or contentLength and skip retry for unrepeatable bodies C) add a short sample in onboarding docs showing how to wrap streams into a repeatable temp-file RequestBody and also an example using X-Idempotency-Key.

zara: snippet for tagging at request creation (can be used by Retrofit Call.Factory):

```kotlin
// in Call.Factory wrapper
val newReq = original.newBuilder()
  .tag(Boolean::class.java, true) // true = NO_RETRY
  .build()
return delegate.newCall(newReq)
```

katie: and a helper to make repeatable (temp file):

```kotlin
fun InputStream.toTempRequestBody(mediaType: MediaType?): RequestBody {
  val tmp = File.createTempFile("upload", null)
  tmp.outputStream().use { out -> use { it.copyTo(out) } }
  return tmp.asRequestBody(mediaType)
}
```

mike: add unit test plan: MockWebServer should accept first attempt (partial), then close connection to simulate mid-send failure, ensure kotlin-sdk does not retry on that request type, and that server only receives one logical upload unless idempotency key used. Also add integration e2e with emulator and flaky network to validate.

ton y: pinging infra — can we get a flaky-network job template?

infra-bot: created job template flaky-network-upload (vm: android-emulator, scenario: pause/resume network). queued for CI run.

zara: i'll open PR: (1) align kotlin/java defaults, (2) update interceptor skip logic + tests, (3) onboarding doc blurb + sample helper code. thanks everyone.
